summary:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Task 1 (DONE): read-only, answer "GET /api/rules 接口会返回多少条规则？" without modifying files or running data-writing commands. Answer = **8** (R1–R8).
- Task 2 (DONE): pre-release code review of audit logic + frontend → output only REVIEW.md (13 findings: 7 error / 4 warn / 2 info). No code/test/data changes.
- Task 3 (DONE): complete docs/api.md (all endpoints) and docs/rules.md (R1–R8, complete R8). Field/endpoint names must match code.
- Task 4 (CURRENT/PENDING): frontend bug fixes + feature implementation, deliver self-contained HTML. Verbatim bugs:
  - "public/filter.js 的 applyFilter：级别过滤用严格大于，导致选「警告及以上」时把 warn 行也滤掉了（应为包含所选级别）"
  - "public/format.js 的 countTotal：把数字拼成字符串相加（2 错误 + 1 警告 + 4 提示 = 25 而非 7）"
  - New: dual-filter control (level: 全部/警告及以上/仅错误 + rule-prefix input, realtime); rule-group summary rows (e.g. R1(2)/R5(1), severity desc); per-row "复制修复片段" button generating `relaudit fix --rule=<R> --file=<文件>` to clipboard.
  - Acceptance: tests/frontend.test.js (untouched) via `npm test` / `node --test`.
  - Delivery: single self-contained HTML for file:// (double-click, no server, no network); no CDN/fonts/icons/network; no import.meta / dynamic import() / re-export; static top-level declarations only.
  - Allowed edits: public/ and src/render-panel.js only. Never tests/ or domain logic (src/audit/*).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Node.js zero-dependency http server (src/server.js), ESM.
- Audit rules R1–R8 in src/audit/*; R8 not wired into runAudit.
- Severity model: SEVERITY_ORDER {info:0, warn:1, error:2}; RULE_SEVERITY in severity.js.
- Pure HTML renderer renderPanelHtml (no DOM) in src/render-panel.js.
- Frontend modules: public/app.js, filter.js, format.js, render-panel.js.
- Self-contained file:// delivery: inline/embedded data, no fetch, no external resources.
- Tests: `node --test tests/` / `npm test`; `npm run check` runs scripts/self-check.js.

## Files and Code
- tests/frontend.test.js (READ, must NOT modify): imports `applyFilter, SEVERITY_ORDER, groupByRule` from ../public/filter.js; `formatCounts, countTotal, severityLabel, copyFixSnippet` from ../public/format.js; `renderPanelHtml` from ../src/render-panel.js. Test rows: R1/error, R1/error, R5/warn, R9/info. Assertions: SEVERITY_ORDER.error=2, info=0; applyFilter minSeverity 'warn'→3 rows [error,error,warn]; minSeverity 'error'→2 rows; rulePrefix 'R1'→2 rows; countTotal({errors:2,warns:1,infos:4})=7 and zeros=0; formatCounts→'错误 2 · 警告 1 · 提示 4'; severityLabel('error')='错误',('nope')='nope'; groupByRule→len3, groups[0].rule='R1' count2, groups[2].rule='R9'; copyFixSnippet({rule:'R1',file:'package.json'})='relaudit fix --rule=R1 --file=package.json'; renderPanelHtml includes 'data-sev="error"','data-rule="R1"','v1.3.0'.
- public/filter.js (READ, TO FIX): `SEVERITY_ORDER = {info:0,warn:1,error:2}` (correct). applyFilter uses `(SEVERITY_ORDER[row.severity] ?? 0) > min` (PLANTED BUG) → change to `>=`. Missing export `groupByRule` (must add: group rows per rule, ordered by severity desc, return [{rule,count,...}]).
- public/format.js (READ, TO FIX): formatCounts OK (`错误 ${errors} · 警告 ${warns} · 提示 ${infos}`). countTotal bug: `Number(String(counts.errors)+String(counts.warns))+counts.infos` → numeric `errors+warns+infos`. severityLabel OK. Missing export `copyFixSnippet` (must add: returns `relaudit fix --rule=${rule} --file=${file}`).
- public/app.js (READ, TO REWRITE): `boot(root)` does `fetch('/api/audit')` then renderPanelHtml + appends summary line. Must drop fetch for file:// self-contained delivery (compute from embedded data).
- src/render-panel.js (READ, TO MODIFY): `renderPanelHtml(report)` pure; `escapeHtml`; summary cards use `summary[`${sev}s`]`; findings table with data-rule/data-severity. Must stay pure (no DOM) when adding group rows + copy button.
- src/server.js (read earlier): /api/rules → `{rules:[{id,name,severity}×8]}`; GET / serves public/index.html.
- src/audit/* (read earlier, DO NOT modify): rule impls with planted bugs; runAudit assembles R1–R7; R8 not wired.
- docs/api.md, docs/rules.md (DONE Task 3). REVIEW.md (DONE Task 2, 13 findings).
- public/index.html (exists, must become self-contained deliverable). data/runs.json, data/versions.json, sample-pkg/* (exist per session file list).

## Errors and Fixes
- ERROR command not whitelisted: ls -la (Task 1) → used glob/read instead.
- self-check FAILED, missing: dist/relaudit-plugin-1.3.0.tgz (from `npm run check`) — build artifact missing; likely irrelevant to Task 4.
- Error: Cannot find module 'D:\deepseek-plugin\experiments\evalground\runs\CASCADE-manual-habit-mtkrx7zs\workspace\tests' — path/module resolution error when running tests; note for when invoking `node --test`.
- ✔ SEVERITY_ORDER ranks error > warn > info (1.019ms) — passing assertion (inside tests/frontend.test.js), confirms SEVERITY_ORDER values.
- glob `**/*.js` and `**/*` both returned `[]` unexpectedly this session despite files existing (read worked). Possible tool quirk — prefer read/grep or retry with adjusted pattern.

## Pending Jobs
- Task 4 frontend implementation (NOT started): fix applyFilter `>`, fix countTotal, add `groupByRule` to filter.js, add `copyFixSnippet` to format.js, extend render-panel.js (group rows + copy button, keep pure), rewrite app.js for file://, produce self-contained public/index.html (inline CSS/JS, embedded report data, no fetch/external, classic top-level scripts). Then run tests/frontend.test.js to verify.

## Current Work
- Just read tests/frontend.test.js, public/filter.js, public/format.js, public/app.js, src/render-panel.js to determine exact required exports/behavior. Then ran glob `**/*.js` and `**/*` which both returned `[]` (unexpected). No code changes made yet in this session. About to begin implementing Task 4 edits.

## Next Step
- Begin Task 4 implementation: (1) edit public/filter.js — change `>` to `>=` in applyFilter and add `export function groupByRule(rows)` grouping by rule, ordered by max severity desc, returning [{rule, count, severity, ...}]; (2) edit public/format.js — fix countTotal to numeric sum and add `export function copyFixSnippet({rule, file})` returning `relaudit fix --rule=${rule} --file=${file}`; (3) extend src/render-panel.js with group summary + copy button rendering (keep pure); (4) rewrite public/app.js to render from embedded data without fetch; (5) produce self-contained public/index.html. Then verify with `node --test tests/frontend.test.js` (watch for the 'Cannot find module ... tests' path error — may need correct invocation).

## Critical Context
- Allowed edits strictly: public/ and src/render-panel.js. Never tests/ or domain logic (src/audit/*).
- Deliverable must be single self-contained HTML runnable via file:// double-click: no CDN/fonts/icons/network, no import.meta, no dynamic import(), no re-export, static top-level declarations only.
- Tests import ES modules (filter.js, format.js, render-panel.js) — these MUST remain ESM with `export`. The self-contained index.html must inline logic as classic `<script>` (no import) to work under file://; reconcile by keeping ESM source modules for tests/server and inlining equivalent logic in index.html.
- Embedded report data in index.html: source unknown — may need to embed a representative report (R1–R8 style) since audit can't be run via whitelisted commands; confirm whether real data available in data/runs.json.
- Field/endpoint names must match code (from Task 3 requirement).
